extract_functions_from_python_code: extract standalone and class methods from Python source code using tree-sitter AST parsing
obfuscate_python_type_hints: obfuscate all type hints in Python code by replacing them with placeholder tokens and returning a deobfuscation dictionary
extract_type_hints_from_python: extract all type hints from Python function parameters, return types, and variable annotations into structured TypeHint objects
detokenize_python_code: detokenize a list of Python tokens back into valid Python source code with proper indentation and dedent handling
clean_python_type_string: clean and normalize a Python type annotation string to use uniform typing module syntax like tp.Dict and tp.List
